verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter publishes some open educational content relevant to founders, including a step-by-step NIW journey page, an NIW eligibility overview, open NIW articles such as premium-processing guidance, and buyer-guidance lists of questions and red flags. Much of this material is service marketing, though, and none of it is founder- or startup-visa-specific. Missing for 10: detailed criteria breakdowns (e.g., NIW or O-1 prongs applied to founders), real case examples, startup-specific visa guides, and independent confirmation that the content is substantial and ungated.
